## Plugin reference

- Description: Tag-tree engine (web): useTagTree reads a declared tree live (the whole tree, in rank order) and useTagTreeActions binds the engine's create / create-path / update / move / delete endpoints to it. Tag-tree engine (server): defineTagTreeTable builds a tree's table from its ref, serveTagTree + the TagTrees.Tree contribution register a tree with its carriers, and the ONE /api/tag-trees/:tree endpoint set writes any registered tree under a table lock — create (unique sibling names, appended rank), create path, update, move (positional intent, cycles refused) and delete (children lifted to the parent at the tag's position, carriers rewritten).
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.useEndpointMutation`
    - `network/live.useLive`
  - Exports (types): `TagTreeActions`
  - Exports (values):
    - `useTagTree`
    - `useTagTreeActions`
